# DtBlkFx parameter scope

Sample rate 44100 Hz, tempo 120 BPM, host block 512, `DELAY` = 1 sec (param 0.5833),
`FFT_LEN` = 0.5 unless that is the parameter being swept.
Display strings are exactly what the engine's own `getParameterDisplay` /
`dispVal` produce -- nothing here is invented.

### FX_FREQ_A / FX_FREQ_B

Exponential: the param *is* a note offset from c0, 128 notes (10.62 octaves) full scale.
`getParameterDisplay` rounds to the nearest real FFT bin via `guessRoundHz`, so
the same param reads differently at a different FFT length -- both columns below.

| param | raw Hz | note | displayed (bin-rounded) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.000 | 0.00 | `-` | `0.00Hz` |
| 0.050 | 23.63 | `f#0:+37` | `23.3Hz` |
| 0.100 | 34.15 | `c#1:-25` | `34.1Hz` |
| 0.150 | 49.35 | `g-1:+12` | `49.3Hz` |
| 0.200 | 71.33 | `d-2:-50` | `70.9Hz` |
| 0.300 | 148.97 | `d-3:+24` | `149Hz` |
